claim: Muslim Pro is a single native app (com.bitsmedia.android.muslimpro v17.11): 250 activities / 27 services / 55 receivers / 11 providers, 29 permissions, 18 widgets incl. AiDeenWidget. Zero native .so libraries.
observed_fact: Full manifest parsed: 250 activities (launcher .core.activities.SplashActivity exported), 27 services (5 foreground audio), 55 receivers, 11 providers; 18 widget providers; 29 permissions; no .so files found anywhere in the tree.

claim: Prayer times are computed ON-DEVICE by a full astronomical engine (port of batoulapps/adhan), not downloaded as tables. Precalc is a sources/regions index (1,143 entries).
observed_fact: Calculator.smali implements getFajrTime/getIshaTime/getMaghribTime/getZohorTime/getAsrTime/getSunsetTime/getTahajjudTime/getIftarTime/getImsakTime/currentPrayer/nextPrayer/previousPrayer/polarResolution; AstronomicalMathKt has Julian-date/declination/equation-of-time math. precalc_sources.json holds 1,143 region entries (precalc_id/lat/long/radius), not time tables. Corrects the phase-1 report.

claim: 22 calculation conventions are bundled (MWL fajr 18/isha 17 confirmed from constants, ISNA, Egypt, Makkah, Karachi, Tehran, Jafari, Diyanet, KEMENAG, MUIS, JAKIM, UOIF, Tunisia, Algeria, Basque, FR15, FR18, AwqafUAE, UIPTL, FixedIsha, Custom) with sealed method hierarchies.
observed_fact: Sealed hierarchies: FajrCalculationMethod(AngleBased/MinuteBased), IshaCalculationMethod(AngleBased/MaghribDelayBased/SunsetDelayBased), MaghribCalculationMethod(Sunset/PostSunset); MWL angle constants 18/17 verified; UIPTL minute tables complete per day-of-year.

claim: Hybrid model: server pushes per-country calculation settings (AutoSettingDto), device computes. KMP network layer is dead code (downloadSettings returns 'No Data').
observed_fact: AutoSettingDto{angleFajr,angleIsha,convention,corrections[],countryCode,dst,hiLat,hijri,imsak,juristic,ramadanIshaDelay,isDefault}; KMP CalculationApiRepository.downloadSettings() body returns literal 'No Data' in both jadx and smali — real networking lives in the app layer behind an obfuscated router.

claim: Adhan plays as Notification.sound (URI of downloaded mp3), not via MediaPlayer/ExoPlayer. Catalog of 37 adhans; downloads from https://download.muslimpro.com/adhan/ to Download/Adhans.
observed_fact: Receiver sets Notification.sound=uri with AudioAttributes and broadcasts PLAYER_ACTION_PAUSE first; AdhanDto{id,type,order,name,filename,checksum,preview_checksum,duration,flag,video_id,free_with_login_countries,is_default,updated_at,legacy_id}; AdhanManager builds https://download.muslimpro.com/adhan/+filename; only adhan_madina.mp3 + adhan_fajr_madina.mp3 bundled in res/raw.

claim: Notification reliability package: setExactAndAllowWhileIdle + full reschedule on BOOT_COMPLETED/LOCALE_CHANGED/DATE_CHANGED/TIMEZONE_CHANGED/TIME_SET + watches SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permission revocation.
observed_fact: Exact-alarm scheduling with permission check; PrayerTimeNotificationReceiver listens to 5 system broadcasts + ADHAN_NOTIFICATION/ADHAN_RESTART/PRE_ADHAN_NOTIFICATION; AlarmAndRemindersBroadcastReceiver monitors SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM_PERMISSION_STATE_CHANGED; AdhanAlarmPermissionActivity (Compose) educates the user.

claim: Qibla bearing uses the standard great-circle formula with Kaaba constants 21.4225/39.8262, fused from accelerometer + magnetic field sensors.
observed_fact: bearing=(toDegrees(atan2(y,x))+360)%360 with y=sin(dLong)*cos(kaabaLat), x=cos(userLat)*sin(kaabaLat)-sin(userLat)*cos(kaabaLat)*cos(dLong); getDefaultSensor(1)=accelerometer, (2)=magnetic field; register/unregister in onCleared; QiblaTroubleShootActivity for calibration.

claim: No on-device Hijri computation exists: HijriCalendar.isRamadan() always returns false (stub); dates come from a server-downloaded encrypted hijri.json mapped to mHijrMap.
observed_fact: KMP HijriCalendar is a stub (isRamadan()=false confirmed in smali); the app builds mHijrMap from downloaded hijri.json ('Hijri file saved: success'). Architectural weakness: server dependency + closed encryption for a daily calendar.

claim: Quran audio is downloaded as per-surah chunked ZIP packs with integrity checks: QuranRecitationDto{s3_path,s3_pathroot,checksums[],timestamps[],sizes[],is_free,is_default}; default reciter pack 463MB with 115 checksums; differential updates via timestamps.
observed_fact: Default abdul-basit-abdus-samad: quran-audio/abdul-basit-abdus-samad.zip 463MB, 115 checksums (114 surahs + index); 8 reciters bundled in catalog; translations as quran-sql/<id>.sql.zip; playback via android.media.MediaPlayer in foreground service (not ExoPlayer).

claim: No Room in app code; user state syncs via Firestore-style DTOs (QuranProgressDto/QuranHighlightDto/QuranSettingsDto/QuranNoteDto) + generic SyncPayload engine; bundled quran.sqlite (7.2MB) is custom-encrypted (not real SQLite), decrypted in pure Java.
observed_fact: Only room-common as transitive dep; DTOs carry @PropertyName-encoded Firestore field names (quran_last_played_position etc.); quran.sqlite + hisnul_v12.sqlite are custom-encrypted blobs decrypted in pure Java (no SQLCipher, no .so). Strategy: encrypted offline assets + Firestore cross-device state.

claim: Quran text/fonts/tajweed sourced from Quranic Universal Library (QUL) by Tarteel — open source, stated verbatim in strings.xml; 8 tajweed rules documented in-app.
observed_fact: Strings literally credit 'sourced from the Quranic Universal Library (QUL)... https://qul.tarteel.ai'; 8 tajweed rules + pause symbols + colour guide in strings; fonts: uthmanic_hafs.ttf, me_quran.otf, pdms_saleem_quran_font.ttf, scheherazade_reg_ot.ttf, noto_naskh_arabic_regular.ttf.

claim: Memorization tracked per-ayah and synced to server (MemoriseStatus/MemoriseSyncViewModel); social Khatam with claim/nudge/badges (NewKhatamRequest, ClaimSegmentDto, NudgeRequest, UserBadge).
observed_fact: Per-ayah (id,status) memorization with server sync; khatam: NewKhatamRequest(name,endAt,physical), JuzSegment/CompletedJuzSegment, ShareKhatamRequest/Response, KhatamHistoryDataDto, BadgeModel/UserBadge.

claim: AskAbdullah is a RAG system: QuranSource(page_content,confidence,sura_id,aya_id,translated_by) + HadithSource + Feedback — sourced answers with confidence scores, deep-linked from the Quran reader.
observed_fact: RAG answer model with source attribution + confidence + user feedback; AskAiDeenActivity hosts MainContentHost (Compose); AiDeenWidget declared in manifest — on-device AI widget with server-side model.

claim: API hosts are api-mp.muslimpro.com (+api-qb.muslimpro.com) and CDN download.muslimpro.com; exact endpoint paths are DexGuard-style string-encrypted and not recovered; manifest sets usesCleartextTraffic=true.
observed_fact: Hosts confirmed in NetworkModule.smali; URL router builds paths char-by-char with keys from ViewConfiguration (needs dynamic analysis); usesCleartextTraffic=true flagged as do-not-reuse.

claim: App hardening: com.pairip.application.Application (PairIP anti-tamper) as second Application class; multi-activity (250) with Compose inside activities; Hilt DI per package; Purchasely billing.
observed_fact: PairIP proprietary anti-tamper (do not copy); 250 activities each hosting Compose content (e.g. AskAiDeenActivity.kt:136 MainContentHost); Hilt modules per feature package; allowBackup=false, largeHeap=true, supportsRtl=true.

claim: Quran search is server-side (FeaturedItem/MoodItem/SearchFeedbackDto) with local result caching (SearchAyaEntity/SearchSuraEntity); no full on-device search index.
observed_fact: Search DTOs show tag/mood-curated server search with feedback loop; local entities cache results only. Classified Partial (server confirmed, full index absent).

claim: Zero on-device ML proven: no tflite/onnx/mlkit artifacts, no .so files, no model assets anywhere in the 1.4GB tree; all 'AI' (AskAbdullah) is server-side.
location_ref: rework/muslim-pro/apktool-out/AndroidManifest.xml (anchor file; claim proven by exhaustive tree search: 136,238 files, 0 .so / 0 .tflite / 0 .onnx)
observed_fact: find across 136,238 files: 0 .so, 0 .tflite, 0 .onnx; contrast with Bark Kids which ships libonnxruntime.so. Absence proven by exhaustive search, not assumed.
